summary: Native App Builder module — full E2E backend + frontend verification PASSED. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (create app with ios/android/both, platform persisted, greeting mentions iPhone/Android/Universal, invalid/missing platform falls back to 'both', website mode regression intact, seeded project verified). Confirm with PM if Arabic-by-default is required when source code has hardcoded Arabic literals.
